title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them
abstract: arXiv:2509.02046v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AdamW has long been the dominant optimizer in language model pretraining, despite numerous claims that alternative optimizers offer 1.4 to 2x speedup. We posit that two methodological shortcomings have obscured fair comparisons and hindered practical adoption: (i) unequal hyperparameter tuning and (ii) limited or misleading evaluation setups. To address these two issues, we conduct a systematic study of ten deep learning optimizers across four model scales (0.1B-1.2B parameters) and data-to-model ratios (1-8x the Chinchilla optimum). We find that fair and informative comparisons require rigorous hyperparameter tuning and evaluations across a range of model scales and data-to-model ratios, performed at the end of training. First, optimal hyperparameters for one optimizer may be suboptimal for another, making blind hyperparameter transfer unfair. translated_title: 神奇的预训练优化器及其寻找之道
translated_abstract: 长期以来，AdamW一直是语言模型预训练中占主导地位的优化器，尽管有众多研究声称其他替代优化器能提供1.4至2倍的加速。我们认为，两个方法论上的缺陷掩盖了公平的比较并阻碍了这些优化器的实际应用：(i) 超参数调优不对等；(ii) 评估设置有限或具有误导性。为解决这两个问题，我们对十种深度学习优化器进行了系统性研究，涵盖四个模型规模（0.1B至1.2B参数）以及不同的数据与模型比例（Chinchilla最优值的1至8倍）。我们发现，公平且有信息量的比较需要严格的超参数调优，并需要在一系列模型规模和数据与模型比例上、在训练结束时进行评估。首先，对某一优化器最优的超参数对另一优化器可能是次优的，这使得盲目迁移超参数的做法有失公平。其次，许多新提出的优化器相对于经过充分调优的基线的实际加速……
tldr: 该论文通过对十种优化器在多个模型规模和数据比例下的系统性公平评估，指出超参数调优不对等和评估设置缺陷导致了许多新优化器声称的加速被夸大，并给出了公平比较优化器的方法论标准。
en_tdlr: Through a systematic and fairly-tuned evaluation of ten optimizers across model scales and data-to-model ratios, this paper shows that unequal hyperparameter tuning and flawed evaluation setups have overstated the speedups of newly proposed optimizers over AdamW, and establishes a rigorous methodology for fair optimizer comparison.
